typographie_suggestion.raw:
Based on the provided image of the book cover, there are several typefaces used. The dominant styles are as follows:

**Main Titles ("ANALYTICAL CHEMISTRY", "LABORATORY EXERCISES")**
Category: Serif/Roman
Subtype: Slab Serif (Egyptian)
Explanation: These headers feature heavy, block-like serifs with little to no bracketing, characteristic of the 19th-century "Egyptian" or Slab Serif styles used for emphasis in academic and commercial printing.

**Body Text ("CONSTITUTING AN ELEMENTARY COURSE...", "W. DITTMAR...")**
Category: Serif/Roman
Subtype: Modern / Didone
Explanation: The smaller text exhibits a high contrast between thick and thin strokes with vertical stress and thin, horizontal serifs, typical of the Modern/Didone style prevalent in the 1800s.

**"New Edition"**
Category: Serif/Roman
Subtype: Old Style / Italic
Explanation: This text features a slanted axis and more organic, calligraphic shapes compared to the rigid Slab and Modern faces used elsewhere on the page.
